requested_mechanism: Continue from qualified negative012 as an explicit exploration parent. Isolate a head-major FP16 V scratch layout for original contiguous V on the existing BF16 noncausal SINGLE_KV path: preprocessing reads original strided BSND with affine per-head 2D row/channel indexing and writes physically contiguous [B,NKV,SKV,D] FP16 data. Main attention arithmetic AST, M128/N256, Q/K, precision and output expressions unchanged; pass correct logical V batch/sequence/head/channel strides for this physical scratch. Preserve original012 flat/strided BSND scratch paths for noncontiguous inputs and all other paths. The preprocessing itself must avoid per-element head/div/mod gather: select batch/head as program scalars, load sequence/channel tiles with original strides, uniquely write corresponding head-major elements. Choose tile size based on actual UB and full-call timing. No Q/K repack, extra stages, compiler-option changes or numerical approximations. Full-call allocation+preprocessing included; retention requires beating best006328.4468us. Keep old auxiliaries when used by fallback. This tests access layout, not IR edits.
analysis: 012官方四项checker全部通过，目标346.69590μs，高于006328.4468μs；case7为283.77035μs，个例变化继续完整保留。012当前实际IR已确认flat预转换由011逐元素gather改为16384宽连续memref.copy，主attention硬件317.806366μs，几乎等同011317.886353μs。012后双分析尚在原不可变目录推进；本轮使用已完成正式四项、主成对profiling和实际IR，不等待父版本后重放再生成，候选保留继续要求完整后取证。当前主BCMLIR的V仍为memref<256x128xf16,strided<[1024,1]>>到连续L1tile的copy，单KV头的行间跨度含其余7头；当前完整2MiB V转换后仍保存原BSND交错布局。下一项把同一次预处理输出改为每头连续的[B,NKV,SKV,D]，保持逻辑V数值，只改变scratch物理布局及传入的逻辑stride，主attentionV行跨度由1024变128，期望让重复读取的64KiB V头块成为大段连续搬运，减少主kernel的DMA组织开销。新预处理按program标量batch/head选择，向量轴仅为sequence/channel两个仿射轴，避免再次产生c//D,c%D逐元素gather。额外读写总元素数保持，代价为预处理本身从连续读写改为一次跨头重排；实际耗时由原完整调用判定。非连续输入保留012原路径，其他语义和分块保持。Triton能表达该布局实验，当前先源码；若编译器仍把仿射二维copy降成标量访问，再据实际产物判断单算子IR。当前判断来自profiling与实际IR，宿主保留此前模拟器知识，本轮模型不新增模拟器输入。011后重放已完成22/22、18/18、18/18且主／辅助二进制与正式评测一致；独立阶段snapshot保留输入值和launch，前置阶段cache热度属于另一个条件。
